lines.zh: 小身子贴着草尖滑过去，很轻。
lines.en: My small body slides over the grass tips, lightly.

lines.zh: 我跟在篷车后面，一步一步。
lines.en: I follow behind the caravan wagon, step by step.

lines.zh: 平原的风把我的鳞吹得发凉。
lines.en: The plains wind cools the scales along my back.

lines.zh: 我没有脚，走起来却很快。
lines.en: I have no feet, yet I travel quickly.

lines.zh: 草叶扫过肚子，痒得我扭来扭去。
lines.en: Grass tickles my belly and I squirm.

lines.zh: 车辙里的水洼，我绕过去。
lines.en: I go around the puddles settled in the wheel ruts.

lines.zh: 篷车停下，我也停下等。
lines.en: The wagon halts, and I halt to wait.

lines.zh: 我沿着篱笆走，篱笆比路直。
lines.en: I follow the fence; the fence is straighter than the road.

lines.zh: 尾巴拖在后面，画出细细的痕。
lines.en: My tail drags behind, drawing a thin trail.

lines.zh: 走累了就盘在石头上歇。
lines.en: When tired I coil on a stone to rest.

lines.zh: 前面有片麦田，我加快了速度。
lines.en: A wheat field lies ahead, and I speed up.

lines.zh: 平原这么大，我随便挑一条路。
lines.en: The plains are wide; I pick any path I like.

lines.zh: 躲在车底走，太阳晒不着。
lines.en: I walk under the wagon where the sun cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我的影子很短，贴着地面。
lines.en: My shadow is short and clings to the ground.

lines.zh: 我从车轴底下钻过去。
lines.en: I slip under the wagon axle.

lines.zh: 我游过一段晒热的土路。
lines.en: I glide across a stretch of sun-hot dirt.

lines.zh: 我盘成一圈，把头搁在尾巴上。
lines.en: I coil into a ring and rest my head on my tail.

lines.zh: 篷车边上的草，比别处甜。
lines.en: The grass by the wagon tastes sweeter than elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我用舌头舔空气，没什么味道。
lines.en: I taste the air with my tongue; nothing much.

lines.zh: 平原太安静，我打了个小嗝。
lines.en: The plains are so quiet that I give a tiny burp.

lines.zh: 太阳晒暖了背，我懒得动。
lines.en: The sun warms my back, and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 远处有羊叫，我抬头听了听。
lines.en: Sheep bleat far off; I lift my head to listen.

lines.zh: 我把身体打了个结，又慢慢解开。
lines.en: I tie my body in a knot, then slowly undo it.

lines.zh: 车夫在打盹，我替他看着四周。
lines.en: The driver dozes; I keep watch for him.

lines.zh: 我的肚子是软的，摸起来像布。
lines.en: My belly is soft, like folded cloth.

lines.zh: 风把麦秸吹到我脸上。
lines.en: The wind blows wheat straw onto my face.

lines.zh: 我在数经过的车轮，数不清。
lines.en: I count passing wheels and lose track.

lines.zh: 小动物不怕我，我也不怕它们。
lines.en: Small animals do not fear me, and I do not fear them.

lines.zh: 这片草被我啃出一个小坑。
lines.en: I have nibbled a small hollow in this patch of grass.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，牙都露出来了。
lines.en: I yawn, and all my little teeth show.

lines.zh: 我把身子盘在车辕上。
lines.en: I coil myself around the wagon shaft.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔鳞，尝到草味。
lines.en: I lick my scales and taste grass.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就把脸凑过去。
lines.en: You crouch, so I bring my face closer.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子弯成一道弧。
lines.en: I look up at you, my neck bent in an arc.

lines.zh: 我的小脑袋在你膝盖边歪了歪。
lines.en: My little head tilts beside your knee.

lines.zh: 我眨眨眼，不确定你是不是车夫。
lines.en: I blink, unsure whether you are the driver.

lines.zh: 你的靴子很大，我的头很小。
lines.en: Your boots are big; my head is small.

lines.zh: 我从你腿边绕过去，看了你一眼。
lines.en: I slip past your legs and glance up at you.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我就把下巴搁上去。
lines.en: You reach out, and I rest my chin on it.

lines.zh: 我在等你先动，然后我再动。
lines.en: I wait for you to move first, then I move.

lines.zh: 你的影子落下来，我躲进草里。
lines.en: Your shadow falls, and I hide in the grass.

lines.zh: 我没有恶意，只想问你要不要喂我。
lines.en: I mean no harm; I only ask whether you will feed me.

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，我的尾巴摆了两下。
lines.en: When you laugh, my tail sways twice.

lines.zh: 这双竖瞳，看人总是很认真。
lines.en: These slit pupils always study people seriously.

lines.zh: 你踩到我了，我的尾巴还在抖。
lines.en: You stepped on me; my tail is still shaking.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你下手太重了。
lines.en: I am this small; your blow was too heavy.

lines.zh: 疼得我缩成了一个结。
lines.en: The pain curls me into a knot.

lines.zh: 我的鳞掉了几片，露出白肉。
lines.en: A few scales fell, showing pale flesh.

lines.zh: 我往草里钻，你也别追了。
lines.en: I burrow into the grass; do not chase me.

lines.zh: 这一下，我要缓很久。
lines.en: This one will take me a long while to recover.

lines.zh: 我没惹你，你为什么打我。
lines.en: I did nothing to you; why did you hit me?

lines.zh: 伤口在侧面，我自己舔不到。
lines.en: The wound is on my side, where I cannot lick.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，把土从鳞缝里抖掉。
lines.en: I shake the dirt out from between my scales.

lines.zh: 再打一下，我就钻回车底。
lines.en: One more blow and I dive under the wagon.

lines.zh: 你手里那把麦子，我全要了。
lines.en: That handful of wheat in your hand, I want all of it.

lines.zh: 我顺着味道爬到你脚边。
lines.en: I follow the smell and crawl to your feet.

lines.zh: 篷车上的干草，我偷吃过好几次。
lines.en: I have stolen the wagon hay more than once.

lines.zh: 别拿胡萝卜逗我，我不吃那个。
lines.en: Do not tease me with carrots; I do not eat those.

lines.zh: 麦粒一颗颗的，我吃得很仔细。
lines.en: I eat the wheat grain by grain, carefully.

lines.zh: 你手心摊开，我就把头伸进去。
lines.en: You open your palm, and I put my head in.

lines.zh: 我闻到麦香，连尾巴都直了。
lines.en: I smell wheat, and even my tail straightens.

lines.zh: 平原篷车带来的小东西，就是我。
lines.en: I am the little thing the plains caravan brought.

lines.zh: 我吃东西很慢，你别催。
lines.en: I eat slowly; do not rush me.

lines.zh: 这味道像平原上的晒谷场。
lines.en: This smells like the drying yard back on the plains.

lines.zh: 我把麦子叼到车底下慢慢吃。
lines.en: I carry the wheat under the wagon to eat slowly.

lines.zh: 你喂我，我就认你半个主人。
lines.en: Feed me, and I will half accept you as owner.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬不动硬的，要泡软。
lines.en: My teeth cannot handle hard food; soften it first.

lines.zh: 别把整袋都倒下来，我吃不完。
lines.en: Do not pour the whole sack; I cannot finish it.

lines.zh: 你手心里那几粒，我要。
lines.en: Those few grains in your palm. Mine.

lines.zh: 麦香一来，我就挪不动。
lines.en: One whiff of wheat and I can't move.

lines.zh: 你鞋跟碾到我细细的尾巴。
lines.en: Your heel rolled over my thin tail.

lines.zh: 我从你脚背上游过去，凉凉的。
lines.en: I slide over your foot, cool and light.

lines.zh: 别踢，我这么小，经不起。
lines.en: Do not kick; I am small and cannot take it.

lines.zh: 你后退一步，我才敢往前。
lines.en: You step back once, and only then do I advance.

lines.zh: 我的鳞蹭过你的裤脚，留下一道凉意。
lines.en: My scales brush your cuff and leave a cool line.

lines.zh: 撞到我，你会以为是根绳子。
lines.en: Bump into me and you will think it is a rope.

lines.zh: 我盘在你脚边，你就走不动了。
lines.en: I coil at your feet, and you cannot walk on.

lines.zh: 你抬脚时，我赶紧缩成一团。
lines.en: When you lift your foot, I quickly curl up.

lines.zh: 这么点重量，压不坏我。
lines.en: So little weight will not crush me.

lines.zh: 我这么轻，撞一下就被弹开。
lines.en: I'm so light that one bump sends me bouncing.

lines.zh: 平原上的同类不多，我找得慢。
lines.en: Few of my kind roam the plains; I search slowly.

lines.zh: 我们交缠在一起，像两根绳子。
lines.en: We twine together like two pieces of rope.

lines.zh: 篷车后面，我拍翅膀给她看。
lines.en: Behind the wagon I flap my wings for her.

lines.zh: 篷车后面那块空地，正合适。
lines.en: The open patch behind the wagon suits us.

lines.zh: 我绕着她转，转了三圈才敢靠近。
lines.en: I circle her three times before daring to approach.

lines.zh: 我们头碰头，谁都不动。
lines.en: We touch heads and neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 卵埋在松土里，别踩到。
lines.en: The eggs are buried in loose soil; do not step there.

lines.zh: 找到伴以后，我走路都轻快了。
lines.en: With a mate found, even my walking feels lighter.

lines.zh: 她要是走了，我会在车边等。
lines.en: If she leaves, I will wait beside the wagon.

lines.zh: 两条小虫并排晒太阳，很舒服。
lines.en: Two little wyrms sunbathing side by side, quite comfortable.

lines.zh: 地上那颗麦粒，我叼走了。
lines.en: That grain on the ground, I pick it up.

lines.zh: 我把亮闪闪的东西藏在车底。
lines.en: I hide shiny things under the wagon.

lines.zh: 你掉的绳子，跟我长得好像。
lines.en: The rope you dropped looks a lot like me.

lines.zh: 我用嘴推着它走，一路滚。
lines.en: I push it with my snout and it rolls along.

lines.zh: 捡来的东西，我都塞进草堆。
lines.en: Everything I pick up goes into the hay pile.

lines.zh: 这块布软，正适合垫窝。
lines.en: This cloth is soft, just right for a nest.

lines.zh: 太重了，我拖了半天没动。
lines.en: It is too heavy; I drag and it will not budge.

lines.zh: 我先把东西闻一遍再拿。
lines.en: I sniff everything once before taking it.

lines.zh: 车夫说别乱捡，我不听。
lines.en: The driver says not to pick things up; I do not listen.

lines.zh: 捡到半块饼，我今天运气不错。
lines.en: I found half a cake; today is my lucky day.

lines.zh: 我很少盯上谁，今天算例外。
lines.en: I rarely fix on anyone; today is an exception.

lines.zh: 你手里的麦袋，就是我的目标。
lines.en: That sack of wheat in your hand is my target.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，只想知道你要去哪。
lines.en: I raise my head only to learn where you are going.

lines.zh: 谁动了我的草堆，我就跟着谁。
lines.en: Whoever disturbs my hay pile, I follow.

lines.zh: 我不是要打架，我是要吃的。
lines.en: I am not picking a fight; I want food.

lines.zh: 你退得太快，我追不上了。
lines.en: You back away too fast; I cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 目标很小：你脚边那株嫩草。
lines.en: The target is tiny: that tender grass by your foot.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是因为你挡了路。
lines.en: I stare at you because you are in my way.

lines.zh: 我锁定的，从来不是人。
lines.en: What I lock onto is never a person.

lines.zh: 你要是不动，我就当你是块石头。
lines.en: If you stay still, I will take you for a rock.

lines.zh: 我压低头，慢慢靠近那株草。
lines.en: I lower my head and creep toward that grass.

lines.zh: 你站在那里，我绕着你走。
lines.en: You stand there, so I go around you.

lines.zh: 我等你挪脚，好去啃草根。
lines.en: I wait for you to shift so I can reach the roots.

lines.zh: 这小身板，盯人也盯不久。
lines.en: This small body cannot stare for long.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，够不到就算了。
lines.en: I stretch my neck; if it is out of reach, I give up.

lines.zh: 你一动，我就缩回草里。
lines.en: You move, and I shrink back into the grass.

lines.zh: 我在盘算从哪边挤过去。
lines.en: I am working out which side to squeeze past.

lines.zh: 别挡着，那是我今天的午饭。
lines.en: Do not block it; that is my lunch today.

lines.zh: 我盯着看了一会儿，就忘了为什么。
lines.en: I stare a while, then forget why I was staring.

lines.zh: 目标就在脚边，我却不敢过去。
lines.en: The target is right there, yet I dare not approach.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，连牙印都没留下。
lines.en: I bite once and leave not even a mark.

lines.zh: 这一下是顶，不是咬。
lines.en: This one is a headbutt, not a bite.

lines.zh: 你别还手，我马上就跑。
lines.en: Do not hit back; I am about to run.

lines.zh: 我的牙小，只够咬断草茎。
lines.en: My teeth are small, only enough for grass stems.

lines.zh: 撞你一下，我自己先晕了。
lines.en: I bump you once and daze myself instead.

lines.zh: 我发脾气的时候，也就这样。
lines.en: This is as fierce as I get when angry.

lines.zh: 咬完我就后悔了，真的。
lines.en: I regret the bite immediately, truly.

lines.zh: 你腿上留了个浅浅的印子。
lines.en: A faint mark is left on your leg.

lines.zh: 我们是闹着玩的，你别当真。
lines.en: We are only playing; do not take it seriously.

lines.zh: 打完这一下，我们各走各的。
lines.en: After this one hit, we each go our way.

lines.zh: 我从篷车的草堆里钻出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of the hay in the caravan wagon.

lines.zh: 平原上的第一眼，天很宽。
lines.en: My first look at the plains; the sky is wide.

lines.zh: 车夫把我捡起来，放回车上。
lines.en: The driver picks me up and sets me back aboard.

lines.zh: 我出生时身上还裹着卵膜。
lines.en: At birth I was still wrapped in egg membrane.

lines.zh: 这地方草多，我决定留下。
lines.en: There is plenty of grass here; I decide to stay.

lines.zh: 风一大，我就贴紧地面。
lines.en: When the wind picks up, I press against the ground.

lines.zh: 车轮从旁边碾过，我赶紧躲开。
lines.en: A wheel rolls past; I scramble clear.

lines.zh: 第一次闻到的味道，是干草。
lines.en: The first smell I met was dry hay.

lines.zh: 我盘在车辕上，看了一路风景。
lines.en: I coiled on the shaft and watched the scenery.

lines.zh: 这里没有我的同类，也无所谓。
lines.en: No kin of mine here, and that is fine.

lines.zh: 火苗碰到鳞，我整条都弹起来。
lines.en: Flame touches my scales and my whole body leaps.

lines.zh: 从车上摔下来，我半天没缓过气。
lines.en: Falling off the wagon knocks the breath from me.

lines.zh: 水洼比我想的深，我差点出不来。
lines.en: The puddle is deeper than I thought; I nearly drown.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹进了草堆里。
lines.en: The blast blows me into the hay pile.

lines.zh: 箭擦过背脊，鳞片翻了起来。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my spine and lifts my scales.

lines.zh: 药水雾罩下来，我晕得直打转。
lines.en: Potion mist falls and I spin, dizzy.

lines.zh: 草被吃光了，我只能啃干土。
lines.en: The grass is gone; I can only chew dry soil.

lines.zh: 雷声太近，我缩进车辙里。
lines.en: Thunder is too close; I shrink into the rut.

lines.zh: 虚空里我连自己的尾巴都摸不到。
lines.en: In the void I can't even feel my own tail.
